name: knowman
description: Search, ask, save and read your KnowMan Knowledge Base from Claude

api_key.title: KnowMan API key
api_key.description: Create one in KnowMan under Settings, then API keys. Stored in the system keychain.

api_url.title: KnowMan API URL
api_url.description: Leave the default unless KnowMan told you to change it.

tools.name: kb_research
tools.description: Retrieve ranked evidence across the whole Knowledge Base and memories. The client model writes the answer.

tools.name: kb_get_item
tools.description: Read the content and metadata of one saved item.

tools.name: kb_save
tools.description: Save a URL to the KnowMan Inbox or Knowledge Base.

tools.name: kb_search
tools.description: Deprecated: use kb_research. Search saved items in the KnowMan Inbox, Knowledge Base and Archive.

tools.name: kb_ask
tools.description: Deprecated: use kb_research. Ask a question over the Knowledge Base, with citations.

tools.name: kb_memories
tools.description: Deprecated: use kb_research. List saved memories and playbooks from the Knowledge Base (read-only).
